key_points: Apple earnings beat expectations but caused a split in analyst forecasts, stock down ~10% intraday.
Qualcomm renewed long-term patent licensing deal with Apple, supporting future revenue streams.
UBS places Apple on Hold and BofA issues cautious note on iPhone 18, highlighting pricing and demand concerns.
Analysts flag AI cost warnings and potential overvaluation (~32% overpriced), adding downside pressure.
Some bullish narratives cite record highs and $400 price target, but outweighing concerns keep short-term sentiment negative.
